title: Natural quotient for two nested open module pieces
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], X a scheme [def-pc-scheme], W⊆V open subschemes, and t:S→V a closed immersion with range V\W. Assume the inclusions W→X, V→X and the open complement of t are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For the module inverse image, open extension by zero and ordinary direct image [def-sfb-module-upper-star, def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek, def-sfb-module-lower-star], there is a natural transformation d:W_!W^*→V_!V^* whose composite with the V counit is the W counit, and whose cokernel is naturally isomorphic to V_!t_*t^*V^*. No constructibility, Noetherianity or finite-model hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 09AH, lemma-ses-associated-to-open; exact extension by zero in sites-modules.tex Tags 03DI and 03DJ. Original filtration proof steps 5–7.

proof.text: Take the cokernel Q of the open counit in the functor category. Its restriction to the open is zero by the triangle identity. The proved supported_unit and open_cokernel_zero helpers in ContinuousConstructibleIntegralGluing give an invertible closed-support unit on every Q(M). The proved closed_pull_open_zero helper makes restriction of the cokernel projection invertible. These are natural transformations; composing their natural isomorphisms gives Q ≅ t^* ⋙ t_*.

The proved generic successor_of_adjunctions helper transports this quotient through precomposition with V restriction and postcomposition with exact V extension. The pullback composition isomorphism supplies the right-adjoint comparison; uniqueness of left adjoints and its counit identity identify the first term and its map. Functor-category preservation of cokernels gives the quotient. The open W→V is quasi-compact because its composite with V→X is W→X and V→X is quasi-separated.

theorem exists_openFiltrationSuccessor
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}} (W V : X.Opens) (h : W ≤ V)
    [QuasiCompact W.ι] [QuasiSeparated W.ι]
    [QuasiCompact V.ι] [QuasiSeparated V.ι]
    [QuasiCompact (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι] [QuasiSeparated (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι]
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (t : S ⟶ V.toScheme) [IsClosedImmersion t]
    (ht : Set.range t = {x | V.ι x ∉ W}) :
    ∃ d : upperStar Λ W.ι ⋙ openImmersionLowerShriek Λ W.ι ⟶
        upperStar Λ V.ι ⋙ openImmersionLowerShriek Λ V.ι,
      d ≫ (openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction Λ V.ι).counit =
        (openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction Λ W.ι).counit ∧
      Nonempty (cokernel d ≅
        upperStar Λ V.ι ⋙ upperStar Λ t ⋙ lowerStar Λ t ⋙
          openImmersionLowerShriek Λ V.ι)
